snippet.title: 1999 TOKOYO Building - Official Release Window Trailer
snippet.description: Check out the release window trailer for 1999 TOKOYO Building, a live 2D-animated horror adventure developed by TOKOYO Estate CO., LTD. Players will need to team up with coworkers, but…can they be trusted? Read their body language and facial expressions, and try not to say the wrong thing in this nostalgic horror adventure game.  1999 TOKOYO Building will be available on PC (Steam) in spring 2026.
